desc: Ideation: formulate the batch-inversion model and candidate greedy approaches.
Implement the O(N) stack-of-batches greedy with next_same preprocessing and latest-batch indices.
Build an exact reverse-BFS verifier for small sequences.
Run the built-in --selftest to exhaustively compare greedy with exact reverse-BFS on all small sequences (length <=9, alphabets <=3) and report PASS.
Confirm O(sum N) complexity and fast I/O for the final Python solution.
Write a concise correctness argument for the h=0/h=1/h>=2 decisions and the next-occurrence tie-break.
